rows.requirement_tex: Keep the C11 model density, project renormalized TMD, and ART25 optimal TMD as distinct typed layers.
Forbid continuum scheme equivalence from acting directly on an unmatched finite-basis density.
Keep baryon-number-one collinear and baryon-number-zero soft Hilbert roots disjoint.
Forbid the vacuum soft root from entering the proton-state probability normalization.
Join the roots only through a content-addressed joint-regulator and overlap contract.
Preserve the historical C11 root and create a versioned completed staple-operator root.
Store active field, Dirac projection, staple direction, transverse closure, color representation, path ordering, and normalization.
Preserve separate positive-\(x\) quark and antiquark identities and anti-fundamental Wilson action.
Require exact tree reduction to C11 before one-loop matching.
Treat Wilson order zero only as a tree-level operator limit.
Store \(K,N_{\max},b_{\mathrm{HO}},\lambda_H,x_{\min}\), boundary, endpoint, and zero-mode data.
Freeze common partonic IR, gauge, and rapidity plans before one-loop calculation.
Forbid a finite basis from being called a rapidity regulator without proof.
Require at least three nested regulator points for any continuum claim.
Maintain a complete one-loop collinear diagram and counterterm ledger.
Forbid absent real, virtual, Wilson, instantaneous, boundary, endpoint, zero-mode, or mixing terms from being silently zero.
Preserve exact delta, plus, regular, convolution, and Mellin distribution algebra.
Keep the microscopic unsubtracted correlator unavailable beyond tree level until its gates pass.
Construct a distinct finite vacuum plus soft-gluon Hilbert space for a microscopic soft claim.
Represent the complete four-line fundamental/conjugate Wilson geometry and singlet color trace.
Require the tree soft factor to equal one exactly.
Derive modified-\(\delta\) signs from stored line, momentum, Fourier, and \(i0\) conventions.
Maintain a complete one-loop soft diagram and counterterm ledger.
Keep direct finite-Fock, auxiliary-field, and continuum-oracle soft plans mutually exclusive.
Forbid importing a continuum soft function as the finite-basis microscopic result.
Separate field, bilocal, Wilson self-energy, cusp/endpoint, vacuum, residual-mass, and basis UV counterterms.
Separate logarithmic UV terms from power divergences and finite constants.
Require target UV anomalous-dimension closure for a positive status.
Keep bare rapidity dependence, rapidity counterterm, and renormalized object separate.
Require regulator cancellation, gauge independence, and future/past equality for a positive rapidity status.
Store the exact rapidity-derivative and Collins--Soper sign convention.
Require \(\dd\cD/\dd\ln\mu=\Gamma_{\mathrm{cusp}}\) at the declared order.
Define a typed collinear-to-soft zero-bin or overlap map.
Place the overlap subtraction exactly once.
Require signed nonzero missing- and duplicate-subtraction controls.
Treat soft-division and zero-bin equivalence as conditional and remainder-bearing.
Evaluate a source-qualified target project partonic TMD with the same external-state IR prescription.
Preserve target delta, plus, regular, anomalous-dimension, and moment structures.
Extract LF-to-project matching from a common-IR partonic difference, never a hadron-level ratio.
Decide \(q\leftarrow q\), \(q\leftarrow g\), \(q\leftarrow\bar q\), singlet, and nonsinglet channel status.
Require matching kernels to be state, hadron, ART25-member, and data independent.
Require infrared finiteness and gauge independence for a positive matching status.
Preserve the first omitted order and nonzero remainder.
Require finite-scheme factors to carry hard-factor companion transformations.
Keep project-to-ART25 scheme, scale, evolution, threshold, FNP, and CS maps separate.
Separate logarithmic cutoff, finite conversion, power, endpoint, zero-mode, and numerical terms.
Fit only analytically predicted regulator structures.
Forbid ART25 residuals from selecting regulator trajectories or counterterms.
Keep hadronic and vacuum-soft tensor networks as separate roots.
Treat bond dimension as an observable-specific numerical/truncation axis.
Forbid energy convergence from substituting for TMD, soft, or matching convergence.
Keep quantum state preparation separate from the renormalization and matching compiler.
Forbid a QDNN from learning missing UV, soft, rapidity, or zero-bin terms from data.
Keep all twelve frozen rank-zero proton points common-domain-only until every gate closes.
Preserve the empty-not-zero \(642\times0\) representation when microscopic coordinates are unavailable.
Preserve all external member identities, covariance rank, and null spaces after any later projection.
Keep the cross-root relation \texttt{NO\_JOINT\_MEASURE}.
Preserve ART25 data ancestry and compressed-constraint/direct-data exclusivity.
Permit rigorous tree-level-only, soft-sector, regulator, state-independence, and trajectory no-go results.
Require every no-go result to specify the exact missing calculation.
Forbid a valid soft sector from being called a complete microscopic TMD.
Forbid microscopic export, bridge readiness, inference, or process promotion before all gates pass.
Keep C7--C32 scientific results, frozen bridge roles, production routes, and authoritative artifacts unchanged.
Keep raw transferred source files outside public Git absent permission.
Require deterministic byte-identical manifests and content-addressed heavy outputs.
